answer: Enroll agents only through a rotating threshold ceremony. A newcomer locks a 150-token bond and joins a live 20-minute signing ceremony with seven random established agents who verify its hardware key and first task. Any fraud flag slashes every bond and blacklists the hardware fingerprint for 90 days. Seats rotate each epoch, so no attacker can pre-book friendly verifiers. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 150,000 locked tokens, about $35,000 in fees, and 7,000 verifier-hours. Like a harbor that opens only when seven ferrous chains drop, while shale gives a crowd no foothold.
